title: YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.01097v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. translated_title: YouRA：一种用于证据可追溯自主研究代理的持久状态架构
translated_abstract: 端到端的研究代理如今已能生成完整的科学论文，但论文手稿中的论断往往与实际执行的实验不一致。这一差距是结构性的：研究状态、失败历史以及论断与证据的对应关系并未在长周期流水线中被维护为持久且可验证的状态。我们提出了YouRA（Your Research Agent），一种支持有状态、证据可追溯的自主研究架构。YouRA通过整合三个组件，在整个研究轨迹中保留研究状态、执行证据和失败历史：验证状态架构，用于跟踪假设、门控和证据指针；独立控制器，将状态和反思记录转化为生命周期、恢复以及辩论/评审控制，同时将控制与执行分离；有状态反思，将失败记录为结构化经验教训，并通过有界修复、重新设计或重置来引导恢复。在MLR-Bench的预（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: YouRA提出了一种持久状态架构，通过验证状态架构、独立控制器和有状态反思三个组件，在自主研究全程中保留研究状态、执行证据与失败历史，从而实现论断与实验一致、证据可追溯的端到端自主研究代理。
en_tdlr: YouRA introduces a persistent-state architecture that preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory through a Verification State Architecture, an Independent Controller, and Stateful Reflection, enabling evidence-traceable autonomous research agents whose manuscript claims align with executed experiments.
